name: What is the typical process for implementing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) services?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The GEO implementation process typically begins with an audit of your existing digital presence and target audience's AI-driven search behaviors. Next, we define content strategies tailored for generative AI models and platforms. AI tools then generate content ideas and drafts, which are refined by human experts for accuracy and brand voice. This content is then optimized for various AI interfaces and distribution channels. Ongoing monitoring and analysis ensure continuous improvement and adaptation to evolving AI algorithms.
acceptedAnswer.description: The GEO process involves auditing, strategy development, AI-driven content generation and human refinement, optimization for AI interfaces, and continuous monitoring.
